trick: A/A test, round 3 of 3: the plain setup against itself
source_note: Season 2 lineup (19 Oct, Meta, headliner; was day 49) and PROTOCOL 19 Oct E4. Both sides are the same plain setup: no overlay, no prefix, the task prompt as is, same model, tasks, timeout and grader. The runner does one with/without pair per trick, so the three rounds are three tricks, d45a, d45b and d45c, run one after another with nothing changed between them. Measurement, no verdict: the verdict line run.py prints is reported as 'what the rule would have said' and never used. Pre-registered output: per round, side A passes minus side B passes (out of 12 each); the spread of the three gaps (min to max, and the largest absolute gap) is the luck band drawn in grey on every later result chart. Also cost and minutes per passed task per side (E6) and the run.py verdict each round would have produced.
tasks_note: Fixed 23 Oct by the E1 pilot (PROTOCOL 2026-10-23 pilot entry): t2 and h2 on Haiku 4.5.
behaviour_count: Pass gap A minus B per round (of 12 a side), and the spread of the three gaps (the luck band); plus the verdict the rule would have given each round
